reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin that exposes Playwright MCP browser tools to an AI for visible, interactive Chrome automation with live screenshots and browser lifecycle controls.

summaries.zh: 通过 Playwright MCP 让 DeepSeek Harness 中的 AI 操控可见的 Chrome 浏览器，并在界面中实时查看操作截图。
summaries.en: Lets an AI in DeepSeek Harness control a visible Chrome browser through Playwright MCP while displaying live action screenshots in the interface.

capabilities: Controls a visible Chrome or Edge browser through Playwright MCP
Navigates websites and interacts with page elements, forms, tabs, and keyboard or mouse input
Evaluates browser page scripts through a browser evaluation tool
Captures browser screenshots and serves them to an embedded interface
Starts, restarts, refreshes, and closes the browser
